excerpt: PROBE front-door robots: HTTP 403 at https://www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt (observed 2026-10-23, standard pipeline UA; Akamai "Access Denied" marker present) — the edge serves 403 at robots.txt itself to a keyless agent, so the robots policy is unreadable. PROBE filing/payment application host: HTTP 403 at https://webapp.ftb.ca.gov/ (observed 2026-10-23; Akamai "Access Denied" marker present) — the host behind MyFTB and Web Pay meets a keyless agent with the same edge denial as the front door (robots.txt on this host is 404, so the one permitted root GET records the wall). The transaction surface is closed to keyless agents end to end.
